title: Rosalind and the Passage
author: Rosalind Kavanagh
blurb: Lena Okafor, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
